description: Combine the twice-remotely accepted strengthened concurrency-safe reducer with the validated two-CTA persistent n176 solver. Transplant only the pitch-89, bank-aware n176 route and its workspace aliases; preserve the 45% n2048 certificate, isolated fallback/repair handles, four-caller correctness, every poisoned/compatibility/strict mode, and all other routes; profile n176 and aggregate integration effects.

Combined the twice-remotely accepted concurrency-safe reducer parent with the selected brief-73 pitch-89 two-CTA persistent n176 route, including only its output-row d/e/tau aliases and clustered dispatch. Official validation passed 39/39, n176 measured 973.265 us, and the full active-set aggregate measured 22683.193712 us versus parent 22680.732. Exact-SHA nsys reproduced the persistent reducer at 856.783 us median (855.456 us minimum), matching the source parent's 856.927 us median while preserving all non-n176 code.

The candidate handle was quarantined while the clean default-math and isolated fallback states remained independent; Kernelguard was clean and official validation passed 39/39, including n176 scaled orthogonality 1.28. Full metric was 23028.708963 us, n176 978.518 us, and n2048 71607.109 us.

The failed candidate remained quarantined and clean default-math/isolated fallback state survived; Kernelguard was clean and validation passed 39/39. Full metric was 22929.464591 us, n176 972.429 us, and n2048 71534.176 us.

Runtime lookup retained BF16x9 WY and isolated grouped repair/fallback while the persistent n176 path remained unchanged; Kernelguard was clean and validation passed 39/39. Full metric was 22674.787052 us, n176 974.114 us, and n2048 71563.589 us.

Strict ATen WY, isolated explicit-TF32 grouped repair, persistent n176, optimized n2048 owner, and independent default-math fallback passed Kernelguard and validation 39/39. Full metric was 23018.135973 us, n176 972.687 us, n2048 71627.706 us. Exact-SHA n512 profile retained SIMT strict kernels and unchanged custom panel/reduction routes.

Compiled EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9 plus EIGH_DISABLE_GROUPED_REPAIR on the integrated source. Complete strict ATen WY/repair fallback, persistent n176 Blackwell route, optimized n2048 owner, and independent default-math non-owner fallback passed Kernelguard and official validation 39/39. Full metric was 22971.012526 us, n176 971.513 us, and n2048 71555.883 us.

Restored production flags and transplanted only the validated active-warp n176 delta from 026ec224: six contributing warps for Householder norms/MGS and 22 for four-lane matrix-vector dots. Stable patch-id exactly matched upstream 34f..026e; all DSM/global/hybrid trials were excluded. Kernelguard and validation passed 39/39. First B measured 22661.642127 us aggregate, n176 974.498 us, and n2048 71582.151 us versus initial A 22683.193712/973.265/71652.245.

Removed only the active-warp delta and restored byte-identical trial-0 production A for a direct bracket; source blob matched 1111d6be exactly. Kernelguard and validation passed 39/39. A replay measured 22669.387787 us aggregate, n176 979.023 us (972.129 best across 14 runs), and n2048 71629.183 us versus preceding B 22661.642127/974.498/71582.151. Aggregate differs 0.034%; n176 B leads the noisy mean by 0.46%.

Restored byte-identical active-warp production B for the final A/B/B bracket. Kernelguard and official validation passed 39/39. Confirmation measured 22648.369941 us aggregate, n176 972.747 us, and n2048 71533.962 us; B's two aggregates 22661.642/22648.370 beat intervening A 22669.388 by 0.03-0.09%, while direct n176 means were 974.498/972.747 versus A 979.023. Exact-SHA nsys measured the fused n176 kernel at 856.941 us median (855.101 minimum), matching upstream 856.911 and prior integration 856.783.

Terminal production certification for active-warp combined SHA aee6811: reuses exact full metric 22648.369941 us and exact-SHA n176 profile, then passed checked optimized-owner warmup, three four-caller batch-1 rounds, and one four-caller batch-2 round with two dense/two mixed inputs per round through live custom_kernel and frozen check_implementation. All 16 isolated non-owner calls passed; batch-1 latencies were 41.1-159.5 ms and batch-2 187.5-629.2 ms. Production flags and sm_100a cluster path remain intact.

Terminal aee6811df61514e90471970911243327f156c714 is clean and combines the strengthened concurrency-safe parent with the pitch-89, bank-aware two-CTA persistent n176 route plus only the validated six-/22-active-warp specialization. Production passed Kernelguard and 39/39; the final A/B/B bracket measured B at 22661.642127 and 22648.369941 us versus byte-identical A at 22669.387787 us, with n176 B 974.498/972.747 versus A 979.023 us (972.129 best). Exact-final nsys measured the fused kernel at 856.941 us median/855.101 minimum, reproducing both source parents. Poisoned, status-failure, unavailable, dlsym compatibility, BF16x9-disabled, and BF16x9-plus-grouped-disabled modes each built and passed 39/39 at 23028.708963, 22929.464591, 22978.635446, 22674.787052, 23018.135973, and 22971.012526 us; strict n512 was profiled. Final production passed owner warmup, three checked four-caller batch-1 rounds, and one checked four-caller batch-2 round with dense/mixed inputs; all 16 isolated non-owner calls passed. The 45% n2048 certificate, independent handles, production flags, sm_100a cluster code, and all other routes are retained. No leaderboard submission was made. Keep moving with a manager submission of exact aee6811, repeated remote validation, focused NCU on the final active-warp source, structured neighboring active-warp counts, or a thread-local isolated-fallback cache while retaining the same concurrency matrix.
